status.summary: Goodman is converting an existing warehouse in Tsuen Wan into HKG10. Its September 15, 2026 announcement reports the facility under construction and targets first capacity ready for service in early 2028. Equity raised for the Hong Kong partnership will predominantly fund mechanical and electrical fit-out. September 15 is the report date; it does not establish when fit-out work began.

status_updates.identity_review: The release explicitly names Goodman HKG10 in Tsuen Wan and links the operator HKG10 property page. It is the existing current-redevelopment record, not HKG09 in Kwai Chung or the partnership portfolio. Geometry remains unchanged.
status_updates.successor_review: The September 15 operator report provides a later report of continuing construction than the inherited June 30 observation. Early 2028 refers to first service of the fully fitted facility; no completion, operation or fit-out start is inferred. The current-condition caption and explicit construction description support the report date, not an exact photograph date. HKG09 and partnership capacity remain separate.
